title: Grade 4 Science — Simple Circuits and Magnets
subject: Science
description: Practice with questions on conductors, switches, poles, attraction.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: What must a simple circuit have for its bulb to light?
choices: a closed path through the bulb and battery

questions.question: What happens when you open a switch in a simple circuit?
choices: It adds insulation to every wire.
It breaks the path for current.

questions.question: Which material usually conducts electricity well?
Which is often used to insulate the outside of a wire?
What happens when two north magnetic poles are brought together?
What happens when a north pole nears a south pole?
Which object is most likely to stick to a typical classroom magnet?
Which item supplies energy in a simple battery-and-bulb circuit?
Why might a magnet attract an iron clip through paper?
choices: A magnetic force can act across a small gap.

questions.question: Which step would help test whether a key conducts electricity?
choices: Hold a magnet near it only.
Put it across a gap in a safe low-voltage test circuit.

questions.question: A working light stops after one wire is removed. What explains the change?
choices: The battery turned into a switch.
The bulb has become a magnet.
The circuit is no longer closed.

questions.question: Which can turn a coil of wire with an iron core into a simple electromagnet?
choices: a plastic cover around the coil alone

questions.question: Which tool uses a magnet to show direction?
Which pattern helps show the space around a bar magnet where magnetic force acts?
choices: iron filings lining up around the magnet
marks carved in a block of wood

questions.question: What changes most directly when a switch is closed?
choices: The gap in the conducting path closes.

questions.question: Which comparison tests how distance affects magnetic force on a clip?
choices: Use the same magnet and clip at several distances.
Use different clips and magnets each time.
Change the clip material at every distance.

questions.question: Which can attract an unmagnetized iron object without touching it?
What usually happens when a bar magnet breaks into two pieces?
choices: Each piece has both a north and south pole.
Only one piece can attract anything.
The pieces each have one pole.

questions.question: Why are wires coated except at their connection points?
choices: The coating absorbs all light from a bulb.
The coating prevents contact while bare ends can conduct.

questions.question: A magnet pulls some objects from a mix. Which mix could be separated this way?
